verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips or any tracking devices. Health authorities and fact-checkers have confirmed that vaccines are developed to stimulate an immune response against disease, not to track people.
verdicts.reasoning_en: An overwhelming amount of evidence from multiple high-tier sources, including government health agencies like the CDC and numerous independent fact-checking organizations, confirms that COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips. The evidence consistently refutes this claim and related variations, such as those involving magnets, pet chip scanners, or misconstrued statements by public figures. There is no credible evidence to support the claim.
